source_ref: Ning and Hao 1997 (Zotero HTDVN55W), page images: bylaws nos. 1-8, 12 (pp. 1-35); circulars nos. 24, 31, 36, 42-46; petitions nos. 325-329 (pp. 700-706)
notes: NO FITTING VALUE RATHER THAN SILENCE. On house practice MB1 is coded on a stated ground of eligibility, not on names, prosopography or an admission procedure (ko_mitarai_*, ko_hokinosawa_1820, ko_horyuji_50kan). The ten practical bylaws do not converge: locality 2 (no. 2, 儒風坊西巷村鄰等; no. 8, 坊巷女人), kin and intimates 1 (no. 4, 親情社, 父母生身，朋友長志 … 結義), friendship as fictive sisterhood 1 (no. 7, 大者若姊，小者若妹), a cave-hall association 1 (no. 5), unstated 4 (nos. 1, 3, 6, 12). Seven circulars name a 親情社 or 兄弟社 (43 and 44 not independent), 13 only 社司: names, not rules. The four practical petitions state motive, not ground (326 父母併亡，更無至親; 327 長值貧門; 328 一隻孤飛); draft 329 (並無朋友 … 全無社邑) tells against reading 親情 as kinship: the bond is made by joining. TWO INADEQUACIES: no value for gender (nos. 7, 8, women's associations); MB1 is single-valued where the she sets several grounds, and 親情 is both and neither of kinship and contract (second instance after ko_hokinosawa_1820, 親類知人). Prior (locality, low) falsified. Ruling 8, records/RULINGS-she-associations-2026-10-13.md.

source_ref: Ning and Hao 1997 (Zotero HTDVN55W), page images: circulars nos. 21-48 (pp. 67-126); bylaws nos. 1-4, 6-8 (pp. 1-28)
notes: CAPPED ON TWO GROUNDS, EITHER SUFFICIENT. (a) The amount is fixed independently of the funeral's cost: 20 of 20 circulars set 人各… in advance, 18 citing the rule; bylaws 1, 2, 4, 7, 8 fix the schedule; nothing scales the gift to the cost or rank of the funeral (bylaw 3, 色物臨事商量, leaves cloth to the meeting, not to the loss). (b) A frequency cap of three draws per household per cycle, reset by a banquet the drawing household hosts: bylaw 2, 丙寅年 revision (每家三贈了，須置一筵，酒一瓮 … 終而復始); bylaw 4 (各自齊得兩贈了者，第三贈便有上三馱，好酒壹角); bylaw 6 (若三馱滿，未上局者，不得請贈). Precedent for a frequency cap: guild_relief_england. The reset cost falls on the drawing household; the cap's unit is per 家 in bylaw 4 and unstated elsewhere; 3 of 10 practical bylaws carry it, none contradicts it. Prior (medium) held. Ruling 7, records/RULINGS-she-associations-2026-10-13.md.
